precedence.rule: Explicit accepted business decisions in SD-01 and later approved decisions reflected consistently across SD-02..SD-12.
Implementation order only; SD-13 cannot override product or design decisions.

resolutionPolicy.missingSource: BLOCK the task, record the missing alias/path, and reload context before continuing
resolutionPolicy.contextDepletion: Reload the required source documents from this registry; never fill missing context by guessing
resolutionPolicy.unresolvedConflict: BLOCK the task; record the exact conflict, aliases/sections involved, and source-of-truth review required
resolutionPolicy.sourceChange: Revalidate the registry paths and affected source documents before relying on prior decisions

scopeGuard.frontend: optional/deferred; do not create or modify frontend during the current backend phase
